risk_summary: The disclosure provides useful quantitative metrics on net interest margin, earning assets, loan-loss provisions, charge-offs, and reserve changes, but is heavily supplemented by standard forward-looking disclaimers and broad, non-quantified risk lists. Risk tone is cautiously positive, while margin compression, higher costs, portfolio quality, reserve adequacy, deposit attrition, and regulatory uncertainty remain material concerns.
